page.name: Maine DOE Event Calendar
page.intro: Our event calendar is used department-wide to share learning opportunities, conferences, office hours, and other events hosted or co-hosted by Maine DOE.
page.content:
Our event calendar is used department-wide to share learning opportunities, conferences, office hours, and other events that are either hosted or co-hosted by the Maine DOE. 

Requests must be made at least one week in advance. This provides time for the event to be posted and also allows for the public to have time to find events. 

Check out some of our upcoming events to get a sense of the variety of opportunities available throughout the state. 

Full Calendar
Calendar Request Form

Please follow these guidelines when submitting an event:

  • Proof-read/grammar-check all wording. (The information you submit will largely be copied/pasted for public viewing.)
  • Follow all Maine DOE branding guidelines. (For example, use “Maine DOE” rather than "MDOE").
  • Spell out all acronyms, and avoid jargon.
  • Do NOT submit your form until you have all the details confirmed for your event
  • If you need to make an edit to a submitted event, email matthew.g.leavitt@maine.gov for alterations
  • Only submit events that are hosted or co-hosted by a Maine DOE team
  • Be sure to check the calendar to see if something else is planned for the day and time you are planning an event and targeted to the same audience. Newsroom posts that promote Maine DOE events will not be published unless the events are published on the calendar.
